content: Streak calculation should be pure, derived from completion date sets, not stored as source of truth. Use local calendar date strings (YYYY-MM-DD) not UTC timestamps or 24-hour arithmetic to handle DST. Algorithm: sort completions, walk backward from today checking consecutive expected days per habit frequency. For daily habits compare calendar days; for weekly habits check each scheduled day in each week. Lazy evaluation on read is fine for local-first (streak updates when user opens app). v1 can skip grace periods; if added later use calendar-day comparison with optional hours-after-midnight window. Cache streak values optionally but always recompute on toggle.
